verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a user-configurable automation or workflow feature in WooCommerce, such as scheduled tasks, rule-based actions or background agent runs. Webhooks are event notifications sent to an external URL, and the REST API, CLI and MCP are developer building blocks for constructing automations, not the capability itself. Automated tax calculation is a fixed built-in behavior, not an automation the user sets up.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
